subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streaming treat models.providers.ollama.timeoutSeconds as a progress-refreshed idle timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling streaming transports, or preserve the documented total request cap?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but it intentionally changes a provider timeout behavior that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and that current docs describe as a total guarded-fetch abort.

options.title: Accept idle-timeout parity after proof
options.body: Require redacted remote or slow Ollama proof, then accept native Ollama matching sibling streamed transports with timeout refresh on each chunk.

options.title: Preserve total timeout semantics
options.body: Ask for a different fix that keeps timeoutSeconds as a total cap and addresses the stall through a separate progress/watchdog mechanism.

options.title: Pause for broader provider policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide a cross-provider timeout contract and documentation update for streamed model requests.

recommendation.title: Accept idle-timeout parity after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted remote or slow Ollama proof, then accept native Ollama matching sibling streamed transports with timeout refresh on each chunk.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans provider runtime behavior and timeout documentation where steipete has recent adjacent history.
